facts.fact: The Deputy Minister of Local Government and Public Works said LADS will soon become a Strategic Business Unit of her ministry, with HIT as consultant.

The Deputy Minister said further LADS development will be funded through a Devolution Operational Grant from government, so local authorities stop paying annual licences once funds are directed to HIT.

systems.platform: modules including Budgeting and General Ledger
systems.owner: Harare Institute of Technology, becoming a Ministry of Local Government and Public Works unit
systems.tiers: 54 local authorities submitted 2023 budgets in LADS format; General Ledger module rolled out in Bindura and Mazowe

note: The budgeting and general ledger uptake (54 local authorities; Bindura and Mazowe) is accounts use, so gives no recorded, held or authorities fact; the Deputy Minister also says most council ERPs are not fully used for lack of skills, undated by count.
